state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`. Stages 1 to 5 are done; Stage 6 (the tools) has two of its three checks green.** The design is ADR 0246 § 3 and § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs_ext::manifest::Manifest` has a `source` field (`#[serde(skip)]`, the `nvs.source` section's files). `nvs_ext::load::read_manifests` fills it and refuses a file outside the class's namespace, through the same `outside` helper `Loader::load_bytes` uses. `nvs_types::ext_lib::hir_classes` copies it into `ExtensionClass::source`, so every command that reads the set's manifests resolves the extension's source with no `autoload` line.

`nvs check` reads the tree's set (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/check_command.rs`, an empty component carrying the ledger manifest, so nothing could be instantiated). `nvs test <program>` now types the suite against `config::extension_set` and installs `config::extension_calls` around `runner::run`, one request for the whole suite (`crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`, `run_test`). A `.nvst` tree run by `nvs test` is unchanged: each case is its own `nvs run`.

The language server still types a document with no extension set.

items.text: **An extension class's methods complete and hover from its manifest, and the server never instantiates it**: check `nvs-lsp` test `completion_after_an_extension_class_offers_its_manifest_methods`. The document's resolve is `resolve_program_borrowing` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:682` and its check `nvs_types::check_program` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:726`; both take no extension set yet. Read the set with `nvs_ext::load::read_manifests` from the tree the document's configuration resolves, never `Loader::load`, and pass its classes and manifests the way `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2184` does. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

**Hover on an extension method shows the manifest's help text**: the same file set. Hover is `at` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs:132`, and a call's documentation is read by `documentation` at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs:272`, which only knows the `Core` registry (`registry_row`, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs:296`). `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.
